findings.summary: Validation of Requirement R2 (Static Site Output) via Acceptance Test AT2 is delayed to Milestone M4, leaving the core static-site constraint unverified in Milestone M2 where the renderer is delivered.

evidence.note: Milestone M2 exit criteria validates AT13 (build success) but omits AT2 (static hosting functional verification).
evidence.quote: AT1 (recursive discovery), AT4 (stable URLs), AT10 (offline CLI invocation), and AT13 (build completes and outputs static files) are runnable and pass on a small representative fixture set.

evidence.note: AT2 is explicitly deferred to Milestone M4.
evidence.quote: AT5 (client-side search offline), AT2 (static hosting behavior), AT11 (modern browsers), and AT12 (≥90% queries in top 10) pass on the representative dataset.

evidence.note: Rendering capability (R2 implementation) is delivered in M2 (DL8), creating a gap between delivery and validation.
evidence.quote: Renderer/Theme plugin (C14) producing one stable URL/page per note plus minimal home/index page; copies static assets (CSS/JS) to output.
